entries.title: Share, compare and report
entries.text: Share any card as a picture, copy an embed code for your own website, compare two years side by side, report a mistake or add a missing village from the About panel.

entries.title: Village cards
entries.text: Village cards now show the sub-district, the occupation date, the population and the Israeli locality built on the land where the sources say so. Machine-read figures are marked.

entries.title: Arabic interface
entries.text: A button in the top bar switches the page to Arabic with a right-to-left layout. Event texts are still in English.

entries.title: Search for sets of places
entries.text: Try "villages of Safad depopulated 1948": the map labels only those places.

entries.title: Occupation of Palestine since 1948 and the lakes in 1946
entries.text: Two new options in Filters show who held the land year by year, and Lake Hula and the Dead Sea as the 1946 survey sheet printed them.

entries.title: New stories
entries.text: "Intro to Palestine", "Settlement and land" and "The changing land" follow the main events in order.

entries.title: Hundreds more villages
entries.text: About 830 places were added from Palestine Remembered and about 330 villages now cite Khalidi's All That Remains. All are marked under review.

entries.title: Painted look, night mode and offline copy
entries.text: The map got a painted look, a night mode, village labels, and an offline copy that can be sent to people.
